snippet.title: Carnage Contest Trailer
snippet.description:
Carnage Contest. A free turn based 2D shooter with fully destructible terrain by Unreal Software.
NOW AVAILABLE for Windows, Linux and Mac!

Visit the official website at
www.CarnageContest.com

or Unreal Software at
www.UnrealSoftware.de

also try Unreal Software's Counter-Strike 2D!
www.CS2D.com

Enjoy!

Video Music: Ramin Djawadi - Fireman (Iron Man OST)
